name: AMB Cinemas to DLF Cyber City Corridor
landmarks: Sarath City Capital Mall / AMB Cinemas
DLF Cyber City Gate 1 & Food Street
chokePoints: Sarath City Mall exit & ground-level U-turn
Botanical Garden ground junction (bypassed via elevated flyover)
DLF Street Food curb-side vehicle drop-offs
trafficPatterns: Direct 3.2 km stretch straight down Gachibowli-Miyapur Road. The multi-level Kothaguda flyover offers a continuous elevated bypass over the Botanical Garden signal straight towards DLF.

routeOptions.name: Gachibowli-Miyapur Road via Kothaguda Flyover
routeOptions.description: Direct arterial corridor via elevated flyover directly into DLF Cyber City.

name: Cyber Towers to Mindspace & Raidurg Corridor
trafficPatterns: Direct Madhapur tech artery. Two options: main arterial road via Inorbit vs Durgam Cheruvu / Knowledge City slip road.

routeOptions.name: Main Arterial Road via Inorbit Mall
routeOptions.description: Shortest 2.6 km direct road via Shilparamam and Inorbit roundabout; heavy signal delays during rush hour.

routeOptions.name: Knowledge City & Durgam Cheruvu Bypass
routeOptions.description: Takes the slip road before Hitec flyover past T-Hub into Mindspace back gate, avoiding Inorbit signal.

name: Financial District to DLF Cyber City Corridor
trafficPatterns: Major commuter artery connecting Nanakramguda to Gachibowli. Wipro Circle Road is the direct short route; ORR Service Road is the bypass.

routeOptions.name: Wipro Circle Road
routeOptions.description: Direct arterial link from Financial District via ISB road and IIIT Hyderabad junction.

routeOptions.name: ORR Service Road / Nanakramguda Exit
routeOptions.description: Longer distance via ORR service lane; bypasses internal circles but merges into Gachibowli stadium queues.

name: Gachibowli to RGI Airport Corridor
chokePoints: Nanakramguda toll gates during morning rush
peakHours: Sunday evening toll queues; smooth on weekdays
trafficPatterns: The 8-lane Outer Ring Road (ORR) is the primary access-controlled expressway (100 km/h) to RGI Airport.

routeOptions.name: Outer Ring Road (ORR Expressway)
routeOptions.description: 100 km/h access-controlled expressway with zero traffic signals directly to RGIA departures.

routeOptions.name: PVNR Elevated Expressway via Mehdipatnam
routeOptions.description: Alternative for Central Hyderabad, but from Gachibowli requires traveling through city ground traffic first.

name: Durgam Cheruvu Cable Bridge to Jubilee Hills Corridor
chokePoints: Road No. 45 Jubilee Hills ground signal
trafficPatterns: Iconic cable-stayed bridge spanning Durgam Cheruvu lake, cutting cross-city travel between Madhapur and Jubilee Hills.

routeOptions.name: Durgam Cheruvu Cable Bridge
routeOptions.description: Elevated lake crossing directly connecting Inorbit/ITC Kohenur to Road 45 Jubilee Hills.
